race.comment: VULCANA (14) was scratched from a winnable race on Friday at the Bool to be kept for this. Has hit the line well but found one better in her two runs to date, most recently over 1400m at Ballarat. Drawn to enjoy the perfect run and getting the mile is what she needs at this stage. Clear top pick. NIALAH (13) rolled along in front and had a clear margin on straightening but couldn't find the change of gears required and missed the placings over 1400m at Ballarat last time out. Gets a tongue tie on today which is significant. Might prove tough to catch. SELITA'S FURY (5) missed a win on debut by the barest margin over 1400m at Echuca recently. The winkers go on - can improve enough to give this a shake. PNEUMA (3) backs up six days after failing in heavy going at Ballarat. Deserves another chance.
